currency.intro: Quotes, contracts and opportunities can use any currency; reports, performance, commissions and forecasts are totaled in the base currency ({{v}}). ai.title: AI assistant provider
ai.intro: The AI assistant (record summaries, next-step suggestions, deal risk) can use Claude or any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, OpenAI and others). Without a provider, or when a call fails, it uses built-in rule-based results. The record's business data is sent to the model, so make sure that fits your data policy. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.

im.title: WeCom / DingTalk / Feishu
im.intro: Create an internal (self-built) app on the platform and enter its credentials here to sync the directory (departments and members) and enable scan sign-in. Register the callback URL in the platform console (shaped like {{url}}; see each platform below). Sync matches existing users by email or phone; people not yet in the CRM are created as disabled accounts for an administrator to enable and assign roles; people who left or were disabled on the platform are disabled automatically.

im.howto.feishu: Feishu open platform → custom app: App ID and App Secret are under credentials; grant directory read permissions and set the data scope; add the redirect URL under security settings.
